meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文章、笔记或一个想法变成无人出镜的解说视频,画面按场景自动生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有文字素材,想做解说视频却不想出镜拍摄
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have text ready and want an explainer video without filming yourself

howto.what: 把一段文字(文章、笔记、主题或简报)变成无出镜的讲解视频:没有实拍素材,画面按每帧自创排版、抽象图形、图表或数据可视化,最后渲染出 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你想把文章、笔记、主题等文字内容做成讲解视频时接管;若是基于网站的宣传或导览视频则不适用,意图不明时先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇讲复利的文章做成无出镜讲解视频
say.note: 会先确认简报,再逐帧搭建并渲染

say.text: 用这份笔记做讲解视频,旁白换成男声
say.note: 音频步骤会按指定声音生成旁白

say.text: 把这个主题做成清单式讲解视频
say.note: 先出分帧策划,确认后逐帧生成画面

howto.what_en: Turns a piece of text — article, notes, topic or brief — into a faceless explainer video. No footage is captured; visuals are invented per frame (typography, graphics, diagrams, data-viz), rendered to renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want text such as an article, notes or a topic turned into an explainer video. Not for a video built from a website; unclear intent goes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video
say_en.note: Confirms the brief, then builds and renders frame by frame

say_en.text: Make an explainer from these notes, with a male narration voice
say_en.note: The audio step generates narration with that voice

say_en.text: Make this topic into a listicle explainer video
say_en.note: Drafts a frame-by-frame plan first, then builds each frame
